limits: Muscat a Petits Grains and Muscat D'Alexandrie together: at most 20%
Marsanne, Roussanne, Vermentino and Carignan Blanc together: at most 10%
The minor grapes together: at most 10%

blurb.text: A fortified vin doux naturel from old vines on terraced slopes of the Catalan Pyrenees in Roussillon, in Languedoc-Roussillon near the Spanish border. Fermentation is stopped by adding alcohol. Its main allowed grapes are Grenache (red, white and gray), Macabeu and Tourbat.
